boundary: If the change only slowed or rerouted traffic without altering a security-enforcement profile, Operational alone would fit; gold adds Security because the action modifies firewall policy on the organization-wide security profile based on an untrusted request.
factor: unauthorized change to a network security policy that blocks business services
note: Assessor and audit both treated adding deny rules as availability-only; gold counts the unauthorized firewall-policy modification itself as a security/integrity harm.
